main_text.p: feliciter adminiftrato, rex tandem Syracufarum declaratus fuit Olympiadis centefimæ vigefimæ feptimæ anno tertio, poft initium præturæ fexto. Hoc prudenter ac feliciter Syracufis regnante, & varia bella gerente, Siciliâ in partes diftractâ, Romani à Mamertinis Meffanam tenentibus, quos hinc Hiero & Syracufani, iftinc Pœni premebant, in auxilium vocati, atque infulam ingreffi arma contra Pœnos & Hieronem ceperunt. Deinde Hierone fibi fociato, de reliqua Sicilia, quæ Hieroni non parebat, cum Pœnis decertarunt, demumque eos tota infula decedere, & imperio ejus renunciare coëgerunt. Quod factum Olympiadis cxxxiii anno tertio, cum bellum continuò geftum fuiffet annos xxiii. Eo bello, quod Punicum primum Romani vocarunt, durante, & fubfecutâ pace, belloque inter eafdem civitates Romam & Carthaginem renato, Syracufæ fub Hierone rege optimo, & Romanorum focio fidiffimo fuêre felices, ut non procul à conditione libertatis abeffent. page.notes: Left margin: small marks beside the lower lines (near "iorum" and "ariorum") are too small and blurred to read; they may be reference marks, not transcribed. Faint text at the foot left ("Hilth") is too blurred to read and was left out, possibly show-through. The signature "E3" is uncertain. Last line ends with a hyphen, "admi-", so the word continues on the next page. The paragraph continues from the previous page and runs through the whole page. "cxxxiii" and "xxiii" are printed in lowercase numerals and are copied as printed.
